summary: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market offering of 300,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.40/share and up to 9,700,000 pre-funded warrants with an exercise price of $0.33, targeting gross proceeds up to $4M. Univest Securities acts as best-efforts placement agent; there is no escrow or underwriting commitment. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The shares trade on Nasdaq under HAO. This filing is a standard shelf takedown and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. No special-situation event is present.
